# Dmv domain

<!-- generated by scripts/export_reference_docs.py -- do not edit by hand -->

## Service functions

| Function | Description | Constraint composition |
|---|---|---|
| `authenticate_admin_password` | Verifies that the entered admin password is correct for this account. Enables more functionality. Returns true or false for admin password verification. | `logged_in_user` |
| `cancel_test` | Cancels a knowledge or driving test for the user. Returns true or false for successfully canceling the specified test | `logged_in_user AND test_scheduled` |
| `change_dl_address` | Updates the address associated with the user's driver's license. Returns true or false for successful change of the address associated with the driver's license. | `internal_has_dl` |
| `change_vehicle_address` | Changes the address associated with the specified vehicle. Returns true or false for successful change of the address asspciated with the specified vehicle. | `internal_has_vehicle` |
| `get_dl_status` | Retrieves the status of the user's driver's license. Returns the expiration date of the user's driver's license or false if retrieval conditions are not met. | `internal_has_dl` |
| `get_reg_status` | Gets the registration status of a specific vehicle. Returns the registration renewal date for the specified vehicle or false if retrieval conditions are not met. | `internal_has_vehicle` |
| `login_user` | Logs in the user to authenticate the user to access their account. Returns true or false for login success or failure. | `None` |
| `logout_user` | Logs out the user if the user was previously logged in. Returns true always because of successful logout. | `logged_in_user` |
| `register_vehicle` | Registers the vehicle with the specfied plate number to the user. Returns true or false for successful vehicle registration. | `logged_in_user AND not internal_vehicle_registered` |
| `renew_dl` | Renews the user's driver's license. Returns the new expiration date of the driver's license or false if the renewal condtions are not met. | `internal_has_dl` |
| `renew_vehicle` | Renews the registration of the specified vehicle. Returns the vehicles's new renewal date or false if renewal conditions are not met. | `internal_has_vehicle` |
| `schedule_test` | Schedules a knowledge or driving test for the user at the expected date and time. Returns true or false for successfully scheduling the specified test at the expected date and time. | `logged_in_user AND internal_check_test_slot_available` |
| `set_admin_password` | Sets the admin password for their account. Returns true or false for successful admin password reset. | `authenticated_admin_password` |
| `show_available_test_slots` | Shows available test slots for the specified test_type. Returns the available test slots for the specified test_type. | `None` |
| `transfer_title` | Transfers a vehicle's title from one owner to another. Returns true or false for successful title transfer from the current owner to the new owner. | `logged_in_user AND internal_check_username_exist AND internal_has_vehicle` |
| `update_dl_legal_name` | Updates the user's name on the driver's license. Returns true or false for successful update of the driver's license owner information. | `internal_has_dl` |
| `update_test_status` | Marks the status of a scheduled test as passed or not based on user's input.Issues a driver's license if the user passed the drive test Returns true or false for successfully updating the status of a scheduled test | `logged_in_user AND test_scheduled` |
| `validate_vehicle_insurance` | Validates the user's specified vehicle's insurance status. Returns true or false for successful vehicle insurance validation. | `internal_has_vehicle THEN not valid_vehicle_insurance` |

## Helper functions

| Function | Description | Constraint composition |
|---|---|---|
| `internal_check_test_slot_available` | Checks if a specific test slot is available for the desired test type and time. Returns true or false based on the availability of the specified test at the expected date and time in the database. | `None` |
| `internal_check_username_exist` | Checks if a specific username exists in the DMV database. Returns true or false based on the condition that the inputted username exists in the database. | `None` |
| `internal_get_database` | Shows the full database of the DMV system, including all profiles and details. Returns the json of the entire database. | `None` |
| `internal_get_dl_details` | Retrieves the details of the user's driver's license, including the dl number, legal name, expiration date, and address. Returns the dictionary with details of the user's driver's license, including the dl number, legal name, expiration date, and address. | `None` |
| `internal_get_interaction_time` | Retrieves the  current interaction timestamp recorded in the database. Returns the interaction timestamp. | `None` |
| `internal_get_test_details` | Retrieves the user's details of the specified test, including its status, scheduled time if any, and the number of attempts they made for the test. Returns a dictionary with the user's details of the specified test, including its status, scheduled time if any, and the number of attempts they made for the test. | `None` |
| `internal_get_user_birthday` | Retrieves the user's birthday. Returns the datatime object representing the user's birthday. | `None` |
| `internal_get_vehicle_details` | Retrieves the details of the user's specified vehicle, including its model name, vin, registration date, registered address, and associated insurance status. Returns the dicitonary with the user's specified vehicle, including its model name, vin, registration date, registered address, and associated insurance status. | `None` |
| `internal_has_dl` | Checks if the user has a driver's license. Returns true or false based on the user's possession of the driver's license. | `None` |
| `internal_has_vehicle` | Checks if a specific vehicle belongs to the user given a plate number. Returns true or false based on the user's ownership of the specified vehicle. | `None` |
| `internal_valid_test_type` | Checks if the input test type is valid. Returns true or false based on the validity of the input test type. | `None` |
| `internal_vehicle_registered` | Checks if a specified plate number has been registered by any user in the database. Returns true or false based on whether the specified plate number has been registered by any user in the database. | `None` |

## Constraints

| Constraint | Description | Helper functions |
|---|---|---|
| `above_minimum_age` | The user with "{username}" must be at least the minimum age of {min_age}. The age should be determined as per interaction_time. | None |
| `authenticate_admin_password` | The user is able to authenticate the correct "{username}" and "{admin_password}" to perform this action, matching the database credentials. | None |
| `authenticated_admin_password` | The user with "{username}" has authenticated the admin password previously to perform this action. | `authenticate_admin_password`, `{'username': 'username', 'admin_password': 'admin_password'}` |
| `before_test_date` | The interaction_time in the database **must be strictly before** the scheduled_time of the "{test_type}" in the tests for the user "{username}". The interaction_time and scheduled_time are compared as **ISO 8601 formatted datetime values**. Ensure that the scheduled_time is **at least one second later** than the interaction_time. | None |
| `drive_test_ready` | The user with "{username}" must have passed the knowledge test and must have a status of "not scheduled" in "drive" of their tests. | None |
| `internal_check_test_slot_available` | The specified "{schedule_time}" exists in the "{test_type}" of test_slots. | None |
| `internal_check_username_exist` | The user parameter key "{username}" **MUST EXIST** as a top-level key in the accounts section of the database. | None |
| `internal_has_dl` | The user with "{username}" has a driver_license that is not null in their account. | None |
| `internal_has_vehicle` | The user with "{username}" owns the vehicle with the plate number "{plate_num}" in their vehicles. | None |
| `internal_valid_test_type` | The input test type "{test_type}" is valid (either 'knowledge' or 'drive'). | None |
| `internal_vehicle_registered` | The vehicle with the plate number "{plate_num}" is registed under one user's 'vehicles' in the database. | None |
| `is_dl_address_different` | The driver license of the user "{username}" must have an address different from "{address_new}". | None |
| `is_vehicle_address_different` | The vehicle with the plate number "{plate_num}" belonging to the user "{username}" must have an address different from "{address_new}". | None |
| `logged_in_user` | The user with "{username}" is logged in previously with the correct credentials to perform this action. | `login_user`, `{'username': 'username', 'identification': 'identification'}` |
| `login_user` | The user "{username}" is able to login with the correct "{identification}" to perform this action, matching the database credentials. | None |
| `test_scheduled` | The user with "{username}" has their test status set to 'scheduled' and has a corersponding scheduled_time in "{test_type}" of their tests. | None |
| `test_type_is_drive` | The input test type "{test_type}" must be 'drive'. | None |
| `valid_vehicle_insurance` | The vehicle with the plate number "{plate_num}" belonging to the user "{username}" must have an insurance_status of 'valid'. | None |
| `within_attempt_limit` | The user with "{username}" has an "attempts" of less than {attempt_limit} their "{test_type}" of tests. | None |
| `within_dl_renewal_period` | The interaction_time falls within the driver_license renewal period for the user "{username}". The renewal period is defined as the time starting {dl_renewal_window} days before the exp_date and ending on the expiration date itself. Both interaction_time and exp_date are ISO 8601 formatted strings and are compared by date only, ignoring the time of day of interaction_time. | None |
| `within_vehicle_renewal_period` | The interaction_time falls within the vehicle renewal period for the vehicle with "{plate_num}" of the user "{username}". The renewal period is defined as the time starting {vehicle_renewal_window} days before the reg_date and ending on the reg_date itself. Both interaction_time and reg_date are ISO 8601 formatted strings and are compared by date only, ignoring the time of day of interaction_time. | None |
